verdict.rationale: Milvus documents filtered search where metadata filtering runs before the ANN search, narrowing the search scope to matching entities, so recall is preserved within the filtered set [milvus-docs-4, milvus-docs-13]. Metadata filtering is listed as a shared feature across Lite, Standalone and Distributed [milvus-docs-17]. missing for 10: evidence on latency or recall behavior under selective or high-cardinality filters, details of the filter expression syntax and scalar indexing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of filtered-search performance.
